hookText: Google just published its Cogentic research papers

beats.say: Google Research has just published the new Cogentic papers in a public repository, covering integer factorization, discrete logarithms, and more besides.
Among them are papers on nearly tight prophet inequalities for subadditive combinatorial auctions, on fictitious play convergence, and more.
The papers live in individual subdirectories of the open Google Research repository, which notes plainly that this is not an official Google product.
